pair.title: Pair this transmitter
pair.description:
The panel ignores Home Assistant until you pair it. Your other remotes stay paired.

1. Tick the box below.
2. Switch the panel's mains power off at the wall switch or breaker.
3. Switch the mains power on again.
4. Select **Submit** straight away.

Home Assistant then sends the pairing request for about ten seconds, and the panel blinks.

data.confirm: I am ready to switch the panel's power off and on

unpair_all.title: Unpair all remotes
unpair_all.description:
This makes the panel forget **every** remote: the original remote, any wall remote and Home Assistant. Afterward, none of them works until you pair it again.

1. Tick the box below.
2. Switch the panel's mains power off at the wall switch or breaker.
3. Switch the mains power on again.
4. Select **Submit** straight away.

The panel blinks. Then pair each remote again with its own steps, and pair Home Assistant again with **Pair this transmitter**.

data.confirm: Remove every remote, and I will pair them again
